caption: The drawing depicts two brown objects placed against a plain, light-beige background. The main object is a three-dimensional model of a rectangular building with a prominent central clock tower topped with a spire. The building has multiple windows on all visible sides, a patterned base, and a pitched roof with distinct ridges. The details on the building, including the doors, window frames, and clock face, are outlined with darker brown and gold accents, giving depth and definition to the architectural features. To the upper right of the building, there is a smaller, separate object resembling a plaque or tablet. This object has an arched top with decorative points and is inscribed with the words “BIRTHPLACE OF AMERICAN INDEPENDENCE” in uppercase letters. The plaque is similarly colored in brown and features shading to indicate its three-dimensional form. Both objects cast faint shadows on the background, contributing to the illusion of depth.
title: Cast Iron Toy Bank: Independence Hall
